نكتمن (form VIII)
# نَكْتَمِنُ (naktaminu) /nak.ta.mi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# نُكْتَمَنُ (nuktamanu) /nuk.ta.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# نَكْتَمِنَ (naktamina) /nak.ta.mi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# نُكْتَمَنَ (nuktamana) /nuk.ta.ma.na/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
